title: Capacity Control in a Single-Server Diagnostic--Treatment Queue with Heterogeneous Treatment Modes
summary: This study develops an analytical and decision framework for a pooled single-server diagnostic--treatment service receiving both first-time and referred patients. A first-time patient receives diagnosis followed immediately by one of $n$ treatment modes, whereas a referred patient enters directly into the prescribed treatment mode. For the two-treatment case, closed-form probability generating functions characterize the stationary queue-length distribution; for arbitrary $n$, a matrix-geometric representation provides a computational solution.
